title: X says it has open sourced its "core recommendation system" on GitHub and that the system "ranks everything using a Grok-based transformer model" (Lucas Ropek/TechCrunch)
summary: Lucas Ropek / TechCrunch: X says it has open sourced its “core recommendation system” on GitHub and that the system “ranks everything using a Grok-based transformer model” — In 2023, the website then known as Twitter partially open sourced its algorithm for the first time.
contentText:
Lucas Ropek / TechCrunch :

X says it has open sourced its “core recommendation system” on GitHub and that the system “ranks everything using a Grok-based transformer model”   —  In 2023, the website then known as Twitter partially open sourced its algorithm for the first time.
